Text Clause(s) 1.0 APPLICANT CREDIBILITY CRITERIA:- 1.1. The Bidders who stand currently debarred by UPPTCL/Any DISCOM of UP/ Govt. of UP or Blacklis ted by Distribution/Transmission/Generation Utility/Govt. Department in India as on Scheduled d ate of opening of Tender shall not be eligible to participate in this Tender. 1.2. The Bidders should not have any pending Litigation with UPPTCL with regards to any O&M Work /Project or related activity. 2.0 Technical Work Qualification 2.1 Bidders should have successfully completed similar works i.e. Work for PD Test of 132kV/22 0KV CTs & PTs at Various substation in UPPTCL/PGCIL/UPPTCL or any Transmission Licensee o r Generation plant during last 5 Years as on the originally scheduled date of tender opening. 2.2 Work Completion/Performance Certificate not below executive engineer is required to be sub mitted in support of the submitted technical experience. 3.0 Financial Qualification: 3.1 Minimum Average Annual Turnover* (MAAT) will be taken as Average of the Best Three Finan cial Years Turnover out of the Last Five financial years preceding to the year of NIT is publishe d. In case the Applicant is in existence for less than five financial years the minimum average annual turnover shall be average of the turnover of the completed no. of financial years. The A pplicant who is in existence for less than one complete financial year shall not be qualified. Th e MAAT shall not be less than estimated cost or 10 Lakhs whichever is higher. The project r elated turnover of the tendering company on standalone basis only (excluding its Associate co mpanies /Holding Company) shall be considered. 3.2 The bidder shall have Liquid Assets (Cash at Bank & Fixed Deposit) and Un-Utilized credit fa cility (both Fund &Non Fund based) available from bank(s) duly certified by the Bank(s) at the end of Month preceding to the previous Month of Tender opening, shall not be less than 15 % of Estimated cost 3.3 Net worth of Applicant as per the audited financial results shall be positive on the last da y of the preceding financial year. Net Worth means the sum total of the paid-up share capital a nd free reserves (excluding reserves created out of the revaluation of assets, write back of de preciation provisions and amalgamation & Capital Reserve) net of P&LA/C (Dr. balance) and m iscellaneous expenses to the extent not adjusted or written off. 3.4 The Applicant shall furnish documentary evidence (Audited Annual Account & CA Certificate). CA Certificate without UDIN No. will not be considered in support of the qualifying requ irement stipulated as above: SI N0 Financial Qualifications (Rs. in Lakh.) 1 MAAT 11.52 Lakh. 2 LA 1.73 Lakh. 3 Net Worth Positive a) The Owner reserve the right to reject the proposal of the Bidders, if: a) The bidder made misleading or false representation in the form of statements and at tachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements. b) The bidder has a poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly com pleting the contract, inordinate delays in completion. 4. Registration of ESI, EPF, WC Policy, Labour Licensee and Electrical Safety Registrati on:- a) The Applicant must be registered in ESI & EPF respectively including Labour departme nt Registration in UP Govt. b) *The Applicant must be registered as Class A contractor in Electrical Safety Department of UP or any other State Govt. or Central Govt. (which shall be v erified) and shall get extended during the tenure of Agreement.

c) The Bidder must submit Character Certificate issued by District Magistrate (DM) valid on the date of Bid Submission. Copies of Certificates in this respect shall be submitted along with Tender documents Copies of Certificates in this respect shall be submitted along with Tender/Bid Documen ts d) The Applicant should also have W.C. Policy or give affidavit to take the same before St art of the respective Work allotted to the Firm as per terms of the Contract awarded. 5. Earnest Money: Earnest Money of Rs. 11600.00 (Rs. Eleven Thousand Six Hundred o nly) Deposited through RTGS/NEFT in the Bank Account of Executive Engineer, Electrici ty Transmission Division, Gonda. Please Enclose Copy of UTR No./Pay-in-Slip against De posit of Earnest Money.(copy of Slip of RTGS/NEFT payment must be uploaded/submit t he Bid of Part-I) 6. Copy of GST registration certificate. 7. PAN shall be submitted. 8. The tenderer shall upload an affidavit (Affidavit shall be made in between from the Dat e of Gem Bid Publication to Gem Bid Opening Date) regarding the fact that they have n ot been debarred/blacklisted from UPPTCL/UPPCL or any govt. organization as per form at given in BID DOCUMENT(ATC). 9. The documents uploaded should be clear and legible. If the uploaded documents are n ot clear/legible, Bid is liable to be rejected without any communication. Firm shall sub mit along with the bid. 10. The tenderer shall upload copy of Gem Bid Document/ATC with signed and stamped of firm in part-I of Bid. 11. Bidder must have to submit copy of agreement and completion/performance certificat e along with Part-I of tender. Sub-Contractor experience shall not be accepted. Bids not fulfilling the relevant criterion are liable to be rejected. The bidder shall have to submit copy of relevant agreements/orders directly placed on them for the specified work and completion/performance certificate shall have to be provided in support of experience along with their bid Part-I 12. After award/ Bidder(L-1) to be present in this office on any working days (within 15day s) alongwith 100/- Non-Judicial Stamp paper for execution of contract along with CPBG and Additional Security Deposit (as applicable). 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission Division Gonda A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
